issue_context.title: Proposed graduation of evictions_number metric to stable
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

I would like to propose the graduation of the [evictions_number](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blame/0d50c969c587c8a6c16e0962118305ac652c5a6b/pkg/controller/nodelifecycle/metrics.go#L67) metric from alpha to stable.

### Why is this needed?

The `evictions_number` metric has been stable for 2 years now.
comments:
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blame/0d50c969c587c8a6c16e0962118305ac652c5a6b/pkg/controller/nodelifecycle/metrics.go#L35-67
I am willing to do this.change all StabilityLevels from alpha to stable? Is that right?

@cyclinder - The request is to have the stability level for the [evictions_number](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blame/0d50c969c587c8a6c16e0962118305ac652c5a6b/pkg/controller/nodelifecycle/metrics.go#L62) metric graduate to stable. If there are other metrics you want to do at the same time that's a bonus, but not part of the request in this issue.

To be promoted to stable, the metrics would need to be renamed from `evictions_number` to `evictions_total` in order to follow Prometheus best practices as well as sig-instrumentation naming guidelines. https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-instrumentation/instrumentation.md#naming.

review_comments: can you inline this? it's only used once so it's confusing when i can't see it in directly in the metric
thank your review! I don't know the mean of inline , Can you explain it or tell me what to do? thanks
Wouldn't it make sense to keep it as is for consistency's sake? The other `*Key` constants are only used once as well.
@logicalhan Does it need to be modified here?

For consistency purposes, I think it is fine to keep it there, although I agree with @logicalhan that it is confusing to have it defined there.

/lgtm
